thread:
Nadia M: Heads-up 1: spike in immediate reassigns last night (owner flips ~30s). looks like enrichment delays + webhook duplicates. thinking of a different approach: provisional-owner pattern rather than hold windows.
Eliot B: Explain provisional-owner? sounds interesting.
Nadia M: Idea: on initial intake we assign a provisional_owner who gets the lead in a "probation" state for X minutes. that owner sees the lead in UI but assignment doesn't count as final for routing/SLAs. if enrichment completes and quality checks pass, we promote provisional_owner -> official_owner. if not, lead goes to deferred-reconcile queue.
Sophie R: That avoids churn because later reassigns won't overwrite a verified owner. Nice. how do we model "probation" in HubSpot/Salesforce?
Tom W: HubSpot: use two fields: provisional_owner_id and provisional_until plus assign_state {provisional, verified, reconcile_needed}. Salesforce: Provisional_Owner__c (lookup User) + Provisional_State__c. Add a lightweight reconciliation job that runs after provisional_until.
Eliot B: What about immediate SLA expectations? customers expect first-touch. If provisional owners are notified, they can do a quick reach-out but ops won't treat it as final ownership until verification, right?
Nadia M: Exactly. messaging to SDRs: provisional leads show "provisional" badge and a checklist: quick intro + wait for verification. we'll track first-contact separate from ownership metrics.
Sophie R: Implementation sketch for HubSpot workflow (pseudo):
```
# HubSpot intake (pseudo)
IF enrichment_required == true AND enrichment_ready == false THEN
  set provisional_owner_id = round_robin_pick()
  set provisional_until = now + 5m
  set assign_state = 'provisional'
  notify owner with template 'provisional_intro'
ELSE
  run normal assign -> set assign_state = 'verified'
```

Tom W: Reconciliation job (service-side pseudo):
```
// run periodically or when enrichment completes
lead = fetch(lead_id)
if lead.assign_state == 'provisional' and now >= lead.provisional_until {
  if enrichment_quality_ok(lead) {
    promote_provisional_to_official(lead)
    set assign_state='verified'
  } else {
    enqueue(lead, 'reconcile')
    set assign_state='reconcile_needed'
  }
}
```

Eliot B: CRM write guard: only write to OwnerId when assign_state becomes 'verified'. Provisional writes go to auxiliary fields that don't trigger downstream assignment rules. For Salesforce Apex pseudo:
```
// before update trigger
for(Lead l : Trigger.new) {
  if(l.Provisional_State__c == 'verified' && l.OwnerId != Trigger.oldMap.get(l.Id).OwnerId) {
    // allow Owner change
  } else if(l.Provisional_State__c == 'provisional') {
    // write provisional owner to Provisional_Owner__c only, do not trigger assignment rules
    l.addError('Provisional assignment - owner update deferred')
  }
}
```

Sophie R: Observability: new metrics: provisional.assign_rate, provisional.promote_rate, provisional.reconcile_queue_depth, provisional.first_contact_pct. Alert if promote_rate < 50% after 10m or reconcile_queue_depth > 100.
Nadia M: Ops playbook: 1) If promote_rate low -> run enrichment rehydrate and mark leads for manual triage. 2) If reconcile queue grows -> spin up SDR rota to triage. 3) If provisional leads show worse SLAs -> reduce probation window or enable fast-verify path.
Tom W: Fast-verify path: if enrichment-ready arrives before provisional_until and quality_score > 0.9, auto-promote instantly. that keeps latency low for good leads.
Eliot B: Can we add a lightweight ML confidence score on enrichment that feeds promote decision? e.g., confidence > 0.85 -> immediate promote. lowers manual load.
Nadia M: Good call. we'll start with rule-based thresholds and add confidence model later.
Sophie R: Feature flag and rollout plan: feature flag 'provisional_owner_flow' default=false. Canary to APAC nights for 72h, measure owner_churn_rate, first_contact_pct, and promote_rate. Success: owner_churn_rate down >=45% and first-contact SLA impact <5%.
Tom W: Also needs UI changes: provisional badge, filter for provisional queue, quick promote button in Console for ops/SDRs. I can stub UI ticket.
ops-bot: [automated] Feature flag created: provisional_owner_flow (default=false). Monitor: marketing.provisional.promote_rate, marketing.provisional.reconcile_queue_depth.
sdrr-bot: [automated] Sample provisional notification: lead 91827 assigned provisional to @jess.s (provisional_until in 5m)
Eliot B: Pseudo PR summary: "provisional owner flow: assign provisional owner on intake when enrichment not ready; reconcile/promote flow and UI/metrics; feature-flagged canary to APAC nights."
Nadia M: Quick sync in 20m to assign owners for PR, UI ticket, and ops playbook. will post results after canary. aim: reduce noisy reassigns while keeping SDRs engaged. :thumbsup:
